# A hospital letter filed under the wrong month

Mum found the letter in the kitchen drawer after the appointment had moved twice. The document is not wrong; its relationship to the current plan is unclear. Write cancelled across the old time and retain the address. [[Care arrangements]] needs a current view and a history, so tidying does not erase why we were confused.
